name: Canon
description: A round from one line: up to four followers repeat what you play, each one gap later and at its own interval, forwards or backwards, and the last can feed the line again.

params.name: Followers
params.description: How many voices repeat what you play. Each one enters one gap after the one before it.

params.name: Gap
params.description: The wait between one entry and the next. A long gap makes a round of whole phrases, a short one a harmonised echo. Moving it crossfades the followers to their new places.

params.name: Interval 1
params.description: Transposes the first follower by this many semitones, up or down. Single lines stay clean, dense chords less so. At zero it plays the line exactly as it was played.

params.name: Interval 2
params.description: Transposes the second follower by this many semitones, up or down. Single lines stay clean, dense chords less so. At zero it plays the line exactly as it was played.

params.name: Interval 3
params.description: Transposes the third follower by this many semitones, up or down. Single lines stay clean, dense chords less so. At zero it plays the line exactly as it was played.

params.name: Interval 4
params.description: Transposes the fourth follower by this many semitones, up or down. Single lines stay clean, dense chords less so. At zero it plays the line exactly as it was played.

params.name: Crab
params.description: Which followers play backwards, one gap of the line at a time, counted from the first note after a rest. Last is the final follower, Every other the second and fourth.

params.name: Fade
params.description: Makes each follower quieter than the one before it. At zero all the followers are as loud as each other.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Places the followers across the stereo field, to the left and the right in turn. At zero each one sits where the line was played.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Darkens the followers, each one more than the one before it, and the round again on every pass. All the way up they are as bright as the line.

params.name: Round
params.description: Feeds the last follower back into the line, so the canon comes round again, quieter each time, with its interval and crab applied again. A held sound does not pile up.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the line as you play it and the followers.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The musical canon as a delay: one stereo line of 37.5 s, read by up to four followers on whole frames, each transposed by a splicing shifter on a short ring of its own (shifter.h: one head, spliced where the wave lines up and only as often as the interval needs, and set a fixed way behind every attack; the search for the splice is after the Smooth splice of the Pitch Shifter device).
